concerns.text: Duplicate functional requirement identifier **FR-001** appears twice – once in the concrete Functional Requirements section (Data Ingestion Scope) and again as a placeholder in the Spec Template’s Requirements list. This creates ambiguity about which definition is authoritative.

Success Criterion **SC-002** demands **≥ 1000 records after exclusions**, but the ADReSS dataset contains only a few hundred participants (≈ 170‑400). The requirement is therefore unattainable given the stated data source, contradicting the project's scope and feasibility.
